fullGoal: An independently deployable, secure, crash-safe, historical-continuous governed learning authority with two separated lanes: owner-private experiential candidates and nonpersonal independently verified institutional technical outcomes, whose canonical Learning writer is unique, durable, replay-safe, and privacy-scoped; returns exact read-only eligible lessons without forging Receipt, Veritas, Formula, Skills, identity or production authority.

independentGates.name: Canonical ownership and source promotion
independentGates.currentEvidence: PR #1 and #3 are still open, unmerged; main is README-only.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Prepare reviewed release line from original two drafts without losing owner history.
independentGates.exitCriterion: Merged signed/version-pinned source on approved canonical branch; no duplicate canonical writer.

independentGates.name: Original canonical Learning writer adapter
independentGates.currentEvidence: Inbox uses verifyBinding/findByAdmissionKey/admit/readback callbacks; GPU-only Runtime PowerShell writer not universal.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Inspect/pin original Learning writer, implement its qualified provider adapter; preserve original append history.
independentGates.exitCriterion: Authentic writer identity and readback on an authorized isolated Learning host, without Receipt/Veritas dependency fakes.

independentGates.name: Writer atomic uniqueness and replay
independentGates.currentEvidence: Source Map mocks exercise dupes, but physical writer across processes has no proven atomic admission index.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Unique constraint on original admissionKey and eventDigest, multi-worker conflict handling, durable lookup-before-retry.
independentGates.exitCriterion: 64+ concurrent same-key submits yield exactly one canonical record; mismatch never overwrites.

independentGates.name: Historical custody and immutable prefix
independentGates.currentEvidence: Pinned source historical reader and synthetic tests for 133-event prefix; no fresh original host access.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Independent original source hash/journal head check, quarantined corrupt tails, owner-approved backup/restore.
independentGates.exitCriterion: Byte-identical known prefix and exact anchor verified before/after rehearsal; no original history rewrite.

independentGates.name: Epistemic states and source event validation
independentGates.currentEvidence: Versioned strict institutional technical event schema; deny unknown personal fields; include verified failures/denials.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Freeze code states, metadata semantics, outcome taxonomy, optional measured cost/transfer evidence with standards review.
independentGates.exitCriterion: All coded source statuses and invalid inputs are deterministic; no inferred failure becomes an execution PASS.

independentGates.name: Original Receipt/Veritas interface contract
independentGates.currentEvidence: Role-separated verifyBinding callbacks and exact hash fields; real signed issuers not enrolled.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Freeze source protocol and two-hash semantics, typed issuer IDs/expiry/revocation, fail-closed absent roles.
independentGates.exitCriterion: Independent adapter-conformance tests reject forged/stale issuer, wrong scope and hash provenance.

independentGates.name: Crash/restart and uncertain-ACK reconciliation
independentGates.currentEvidence: Source fixtures cover lost ACK and process re-open; no canonical writer kill/disk-full persistence test.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Implement persisted reconciliation index on original writer and exact restart-safe source consumer state.
independentGates.exitCriterion: Crash at all Learning write/readback/ACK boundaries never double-admits or blindly ACKs.

independentGates.name: Private candidate encrypted journal
independentGates.currentEvidence: Source AES-256-GCM vault, lock, fsync, integrity and owner-scoped projections, but ephemeral test keys.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Package approved storage layout and owner key-provider contract, lock expiry/recovery and invalid tail quarantine.
independentGates.exitCriterion: Real owner key and restart test, denied wrong key/scope and verifiable private journal readback.

independentGates.name: Identity, consent, corrections and revocation
independentGates.currentEvidence: Private source projection suppresses opted-out views; externally authenticated owner/permission lifecycle not demonstrated.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Bind owner identity, collection/personalization consent separation, corrections/supersession and policy checks.
independentGates.exitCriterion: Denied/unconsented owner requests reveal no data; revocations remove derived views immediately.

independentGates.name: Privacy retention, export and erasure
independentGates.currentEvidence: Private encrypted journal lacks owner-authorized export/deletion, retention policy and key rotation qualification.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Create explicit privacy retention index, export, deletion/crypto-erasure proof and independent policy review.
independentGates.exitCriterion: Owner-scoped export, correction, revocation and erasure tested with durable recovery and legal holds.

independentGates.name: Recovery backups and portable storage
independentGates.currentEvidence: Local encrypted candidate writer only; no qualified original journal backup/restore/replica across hosts.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Implement verified snapshot/restore preserving exact original history; use approved Continuum transport only after independent qualification.
independentGates.exitCriterion: Rebuild bytes/journal indexes on a clean host and prove recoverability after loss.

independentGates.name: Institutional read-only reference projection
independentGates.currentEvidence: Bounded metadata-only query checks, rejects raw prompts/private owner records, no skill mutation.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Finalize output version, access-control adapter and indexed readback consistency.
independentGates.exitCriterion: Authorized reader receives only coded verified records, and unauthorized reader always denied.

independentGates.name: Private owner-scoped University candidate projection
independentGates.currentEvidence: Source read-only candidate-context adapter requires head anchor and owner callback; cannot mint authority.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Finalize private output/consent model and exact source provenance for downstream adapter.
independentGates.exitCriterion: Candidate remains CANDIDATE_CONTEXT_ONLY with no ability to issue action or verified lesson.

independentGates.name: Tenant isolation and injection-safe retrieval
independentGates.currentEvidence: Tests reject mixed-scope and exclude raw prompt from institutional output; live auth and negative search isolation unqualified.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Harden index-side scope filters, no prompt/tool authority, cross-user RAG adversarial test suite.
independentGates.exitCriterion: N-way tenants and hostile retrieved strings never cross scope, issue tools or alter permissions.

independentGates.name: Portable deployment and service discovery
independentGates.currentEvidence: No installed standalone Learning provider/health contract; the historical writer is local Windows-specific.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Node22-native capability adapter or authorized Windows-original-writer bridge using runtime configuration, explicit data root, health and readiness.
independentGates.exitCriterion: Install and restart without default E:/ or C:/, outside CI; all routes resolve approved owner-scoped storage.

independentGates.name: Component test suite and cross-platform quality
independentGates.currentEvidence: Source Node22 GitHub Actions 92/92 pass, four engineering checkpoints; no independent Windows/Linux end-to-end writer test.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Expand fault injection, stable golden vectors, verify full engineering archive and reproducible cross-platform smoke.
independentGates.exitCriterion: Full Learning-only suite including actual storage survives repeat Windows/Linux restarts without mocks.

independentGates.name: Observability, reconcile queue and operator controls
independentGates.currentEvidence: Source has statuses but no live durable queue metrics, provider discovery and scoped operator-safe reconcile UI.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Implement read-only health, counts by state, bounded retry, backpressure and dispute quarantine with receipts.
independentGates.exitCriterion: Outages report accurate PENDING/BLOCKED/DISPUTED without false green; repair can resume only after evidence.

independentGates.name: Original-release provenance and rollback
independentGates.currentEvidence: Two stacked source-only drafts and no approved release artifact or installed version pin.
independentGates.componentOwnedWork: Publish reviewed reproducible release with source digest, config contract, immutable migration plan and rollback.
independentGates.exitCriterion: Independent artifact hash, no hidden historical writes, rollback restores service without losing receipts.

externalProviderPrerequisites.contract: Atomically commit canonical execution receipt plus eligible nonpersonal Learning obligation and supply authenticated readCommittedObligation, verifyAtomicReceiptCommit, listPendingObligationIds and Receipt-owned delivery ACK
Bound issuer cryptographic PRE/POST, privacyCleared and transferEligible with revocation and exact source/context keys
True same-request Formula and observed physical execution, provider registry and original end-to-end mission
Versioned original authority registry, approved policy and trust-root enrollment/rollback
Qualified owner-scoped storage and exact byte backup/recovery transport for persistent private candidate data
Read-only independently authorized, privacy-scoped retrieval; no skill execution or policy promotion

statusSemantics.SOURCE_TESTED: Source module and synthetic tests exist only.
statusSemantics.PARTIAL_SOURCE: Some source behavior exists; required own component behavior remains incomplete or unverified.
statusSemantics.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: No verified component implementation/evidence for stated independent gate.
statusSemantics.UNVERIFIED: No adequate source inspection to classify.
statusSemantics.INDEPENDENTLY_QUALIFIED: Reserved for separately authenticated real component acceptance, never emitted by this source snapshot.
